Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses a specialized N-terminomics approach (SILProNAQ) involving chemical acetylation of free amino groups followed by SCX enrichment. While SRM was used for specific protein quantification (MetAP1/2), the global profiling was performed via DDA (Top 20). The labeling described (d3-acetyl) is a chemical derivatization for N-terminal identification rather than a standard multiplexing strategy like TMT.
